positive_cases.name: background_transfer_job
positive_cases.scenario: Background transfer utility creating a download job.
positive_cases.rationale: Utility and transfer switch selections satisfy the condition.

positive_cases.name: installer_remote_package
positive_cases.scenario: Installer utility pointed at a synthetic remote package.
positive_cases.rationale: Utility and remote scheme selections satisfy the condition.

negative_cases.name: local_package_install
negative_cases.scenario: Installer utility installing a local package.
negative_cases.rationale: Utility matches but neither branch of the condition does.

negative_cases.name: download_manager_with_url
negative_cases.scenario: Dedicated download manager retrieving a synthetic file.
negative_cases.rationale: Remote scheme matches but the image is not in the utility list.

negative_cases.name: transfer_utility_job_listing
negative_cases.scenario: Background transfer utility listing existing jobs.
negative_cases.rationale: Utility matches but there is no remote scheme or transfer switch.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
